nom: Makari Kojic Acid Dark Spot Remover Soap Bars

concerns.spots: Most reviewers report gradual fading of dark spots, sun spots, or old stubborn marks with consistent use over weeks, describing the change as visible but not overnight; one reviewer with minimal fair-skin spots saw no improvement after a month.
concerns.blemishes: One reviewer reports the soap helped fade leftover marks from past breakouts, leaving skin looking clearer and more even.

aspects.libelle: Evens and smooths overall skin tone

extraits.titre: Didn't remove dark spots after 1 month
extraits.texte: I have cery minimal dark spots and im fair skin. Its soft to skin does not irritate but after a month of use i see no improvement
I mainly use this on specific dark areas and it's been effective. The spots are slowly fading and my skin tone looks more even.
I've been dealing with sun spots for a while and this soap has helped lighten them gradually. My skin looks more balanced now.
I've been using this soap on some old dark spots and I'm finally seeing them lighten. It's not overnight, but the progress is real and consistent.
I was worried it might dry out my skin, but it's actually pretty balanced. My skin feels clean and looks brighter without feeling tight.
I had a lot of leftover marks from breakouts and this soap has helped fade them over time. My skin looks clearer and more even now.

reserve: Reviews rarely state a specific skin type (oily, dry, sensitive, etc.), so type-based segmentation could not be produced from this set.
